BM25 filter with very high threshold filters out all pages

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"bm25_query\":\"quantum physics\",\"bm25_threshold\":100.0,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(length(result.pages))
```
